prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 professional recording-studio portrait of an adult woman with long natural red hair, blue eyes, and a calm thoughtful expression. She wears a white long-sleeve studio shirt with a modest crew neckline, loose soft-pink sweatpants, black over-ear headphones, and simple unbranded jewelry. Place her near a large condenser microphone and pop filter, standing with one hand on her hip and looking slightly upward as if preparing to record vocals. Include charcoal acoustic panels, warm wood accents, a microphone stand, soft indoor light, realistic skin and hair, accurate studio equipment, and no logos or readable text.
